entries.sense_note: learn naturally, not lift or collect

def.short: learn a language or skill easily, without real lessons
def.long: To learn a language or skill easily, just by hearing, watching or doing it, not by studying in a class. Typical uses: pick up a language, pick up a few words.

grammar.pattern: pick up sth / pick sth up (pick it up)

examples.en: Berk picked up some Spanish on holiday.
I picked up a lot of English from TV series.
Nil lived in London for a year and picked up the language from her neighbors.
examples.tr: Nil bir yıl Londra'da yaşadı ve dili komşularından öğrendi.

tr.note: Bu kart 'pick up' fiilinin üçüncü anlamı: ders almadan, duyarak ya da yaşayarak öğrenmek. 'Yerden almak' ve 'birini arabayla almak' anlamları ayrı kartlarda.

quiz.cloze: I never took Italian lessons. I just ______ some words in Rome.

def.short: study or practice again something you learned before but partly forgot
def.long: To study or practice again something you learned before but have partly forgotten, often before you need it. For example: brush up on your English before a trip.

grammar.pattern: brush up on sth (brush up on my English)

examples.en: I need to brush up on my English before the trip.
Ethan is brushing up on his French with a free app.
examples.tr: Ethan ücretsiz bir uygulamayla Fransızcasını tazeliyor.

examples.en: Before the interview, Ana brushed up on the grammar she learned at school.
examples.tr: Ana mülakattan önce okulda öğrendiği dil bilgisinin üzerinden geçti.

tr.note: Daha önce bildiğin ama biraz unuttuğun şey için kullanılır; hiç bilmediğin bir şey için değil. İngiliz İngilizcesinde 'on' olmadan da duyulur: 'brush up my French'.

quiz.cloze: I forgot a lot of my school German. Before my new job in Berlin, I must ______ my German.

def.short: manage with only a little knowledge, money or help
def.long: To manage a situation with only a little knowledge, money or help. It is not perfect, but it is enough: I can get by in English.

grammar.pattern: get by (in English / on little money)

examples.en: My English isn't perfect, but I can get by.
examples.tr: İngilizcem mükemmel değil ama idare edebiliyorum.

examples.en: Kaan knows only a few Italian words, but he gets by in Rome.
examples.tr: Kaan sadece birkaç İtalyanca kelime biliyor ama Roma'da idare ediyor.

examples.en: With a translation app and some simple phrases, Chloe got by in Japan for two weeks.
examples.tr: Chloe bir çeviri uygulaması ve birkaç basit kalıpla Japonya'da iki hafta idare etti.

tr.note: Para için de kullanılır: 'get by on 900 euros a month' (ayda 900 avroyla geçinmek). Dil için 'get by in English' kalıbı çok yaygındır.

quiz.cloze: I only know a few words of Greek, but it's enough to ______ in shops.

def.short: able to speak a language easily and well, without stopping
def.long: Able to speak or write a language easily and well, without stopping to think about every word. We say fluent in English or fluent English.

grammar.pattern: be fluent in + language / fluent + language

examples.en: Nil is fluent in three languages.
After a year in Canada, Berk's English became really fluent.
examples.tr: Kanada'da geçen bir yılın ardından Berk'in İngilizcesi gerçekten akıcı hâle geldi.

examples.en: You don't need to be fluent to travel; a few simple sentences are enough.
examples.tr: Seyahat etmek için akıcı konuşman gerekmez; birkaç basit cümle yeter.

etymology.text: From Latin 'fluens', 'flowing', from 'fluere', 'to flow'. Fluent speech flows like water.

tr.note: Fiili nitelerken zarf biçimi 'fluently' kullanılır: 'She speaks English fluently.' Kişi için 'fluent in English' denir.

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'akıcı' hem sıfat hem zarf gibi kullanılır ('akıcı konuşmak'). İngilizcede fiili zarf niteler: 'fluently'. Ya da 'I'm fluent in English' diyebilirsin.

quiz.cloze: Ana lived in Spain for five years, so she's ______ in Spanish.

def.short: the way people from a place or country say words when they speak
def.long: The way a person says words, which often shows the country or area they come from. Common phrases: a Turkish accent, a strong accent.

grammar.pattern: a/an + adj + accent; speak with an accent

examples.en: Chloe has a lovely French accent.
examples.tr: Chloe'nin hoş bir Fransız aksanı var.

examples.en: Don't worry about your accent; people can understand you.
examples.tr: Aksanını dert etme; insanlar seni anlayabiliyor.

examples.en: Ethan speaks Turkish well, but he still has a strong American accent.
examples.tr: Ethan Türkçeyi iyi konuşuyor ama hâlâ belirgin bir Amerikan aksanı var.

etymology.text: From Latin 'accentus', from 'ad' (to) and 'cantus' (song); it first meant the rise and fall of the voice.

tr.note: Accent yalnızca sesle ilgilidir. Kelimeleri ve dil bilgisini de kapsayan bölgesel konuşma biçimine 'dialect' (lehçe, ağız) denir.

quiz.cloze: When Kaan speaks English, people hear his Turkish ______ right away.
